answer: A walnut-shell vault stops sybils: each agent seals a hardware key plus a 200 POA bond in a vault paying out only after 30 days of verified work. First, it stakes the bond and lists the key on a mesa ledger, where every identity sits in plain sight. Second, it completes 16 deliveries in 28 days, each signed by a different peer. Third, a random 1-in-4 audit replays the dune trail of its deals; forgery burns the bond and voids the key for 3 years. Faking 10,000 agents burns 2,000,000 POA, needs 10,000 keys and 160,000 deliveries. Like cracking walnuts one by one, the work defeats the swarm.
